phases.title: Prepare
phases.blurb: Risk is set in school. The strongest predictors of becoming NEET are need and absence, and the foundations of engagement, including vocational tasters and employer contact, are laid here.

phases.title: Transition
phases.blurb: The handover from school to college and work. Funding rules, a thin apprenticeship offer and a long tail of weak providers leave too many without a sustained destination.

phases.blurb: Turning participation into work. Apprenticeships have the strongest returns of any youth employment route, but starts have collapsed and university returns are uneven.
